purpose: MNIST pipeline sanity; no engine-leadership claim from this task alone
wall_scope: Coordinator before fresh worker launch through cold imports/compile, array verification, A1 numerical qualification, input construction/copy, full training API, complete validation, checkpoint I/O and once-only final test. No additional test grace budget.
encoding: Cast original uint8 pixels to float64, divide by255.0, flatten row-major784; repeat the same analogue current for all100ticks. No Poisson draw, augmentation or feature fit.
split: Use existing immutable data/mnist/processed train_indices.npy and validation_indices.npy. Official test images and labels are decoded only after a full-epoch selected checkpoint exists.

initial_parameters.draw_order: input-to-hidden then hidden-to-output; source-major flattened banks
initial_parameters.shared_arrays: Materialize all five seeds before fitting; archive bytes and SHA256. Engines load common arrays rather than regenerate from equal seed.

shuffle.rule: For each epoch in1..10 draw one complete permutation of the frozen55000 training indices; archive all10 permutations before fitting.
shuffle.validation_order: ascending immutable validation_indices, all5000; final batch8

numeric_profile.optimizer: float64 Adam; lr0.001, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, epsilon=1e-8, weight_decay=0
numeric_profile.batch_reduction: mean over actual batch size, including24sample final training batch; one Adam step per batch
numeric_profile.state: Explicit zero voltage per example; no carry across batches
numeric_profile.equations: canonical_lif_v1: drift/strict threshold before synaptic update; beta0.95, theta1, detached subtract reset; fast-sigmoid VJP slope5

resource_profile: Atlas CPU and Torch CPU requested1compute thread; macOS core affinity unavailable. JAX is not implemented by the initial pipeline and must not be silently substituted.
compile: Optional Torch compile is a separate view; fresh per-run cache and actual-path A1 qualification required; cold compile consumes the same1800s cap.
qualification: Require matching prior dense Q0. Within the1800s worker, compare three actual full-B32/T100 MNIST training updates against independent oracle: loss, parameter gradients, weights and Adam moments. Reset to common initial arrays before epoch1. Small/dynamic final batch must retain declared semantics; actual tail-shape qualification is also required.
selection: Complete all55000 training samples and all5000 validation samples before an epoch is eligible. Select maximal integer validation correct count; earliest epoch wins ties. Save each improved checkpoint with hash before committing the selection record.
continue_training_rule: After each complete epoch and checkpoint bookkeeping, continue only if another epoch remains and remaining seconds exceed1.10*just_completed_epoch_wall + 1.25*2*just_completed_validation_wall +2.0. Otherwise begin final evaluation. This fixed reserve heuristic may still censor test at the hard cap.

test_policy.gate: A selected checkpoint from a fully completed epoch exists and wall budget remains; restore that checkpoint, write durable test-start marker, then decode official test bytes.
test_policy.completion: Report test accuracy/loss only after all10000 samples finish within the same1800s cap.
test_policy.cap_before_any_epoch: censored; no selected checkpoint; test labels remain sealed
test_policy.cap_during_test: test_status=censored_at_cap; retain bestvalidation/checkpoint; no partial test accuracy and no retry
test_policy.once_only_ledger: Exclusive-create evidence/a1-v4-test-once/{view}-seed-{seed}-{contract_sha256}.json before decoding test labels; persists across fresh run directories, preventing retry of the same formal view/seed.

failure_policy: Keep unsupported, unqualified, dependency failure, budget_rejected, timeout, divergence and incomplete test as separate outcomes; preserve all five formal seeds and original sample/epoch denominators. No truncated epoch, shorterT, smaller global batch or extra cap after results.
freeze_basis: Coordinator review before any A1 execution; existing user authorization covers this evaluation. --allow-run is an accidental-execution guard, not a request for new user approval.
qualification_engine_binding: q0 report engine must exactly match requested engine; all Torch Q0 raw compile flags must match requested compile mode; Atlas Q0 raw runtime/training API hashes must match.
supervision: Track own descendants by PID+creation time, including independent sessions; clean tracked remnants also after normal worker exit; Popen.wait exclusively reaps direct worker, preserving signal exit code.

prior_revision.execution_state: v3 preserved, never uploaded or executed as an A1 model/data workload

revision_reason: Preserve strict >0 neuron threshold in validation/test by keeping Torch/SJ training mode and disabling autograd only; add actual no-gradient threshold boundary qualification before fitting.

evaluation_forward_policy.atlas: Native evaluate operation with explicit initial state, no optimizer update
evaluation_forward_policy.torch: model.train(True) for training, validation and final test; torch.set_grad_enabled(False) only during validation/test
evaluation_forward_policy.reason: This model contains no Dropout or BatchNorm; SpikingJelly eval mode otherwise replaces the configured strict surrogate with >=0 heaviside.
evaluation_forward_policy.actual_path: record_states=False; same model callable for qualification and measured workload, including optional torch.compile

boundary_qualification.budget: Included in the same strict 1800 second total wall cap, including optional extra compile
boundary_qualification.explicit_initial_scope: Qualification-only B2 full-width 784-128-10, selected hidden/output voltages at neighboring representable FP64 values around theta/beta; all training/validation/test batches still begin at zero
boundary_qualification.full_shape: B2,T100 actual no-gradient callable versus independent oracle loss/logits; Atlas also compares all actual native first-tick spikes
boundary_qualification.actual_margin: Record actual charged voltage minus threshold for both real Torch neuron cells under no_grad and train(True); each cell must include exactly zero margin and return strict >0 spikes, with negative and positive neighbors
boundary_qualification.compiled_observability: Additional B2,T1 full-width no-gradient fixture through the same eager/compiled callable directly checks first-output logits == 5*strict-threshold-spikes and independent oracle; clearly auxiliary, does not shorten formal T100
boundary_qualification.direct_surrogate: Record strict spike outputs for explicit margins [-2^-20,0,+2^-20] under no_grad; eager cell checks do not substitute for compiled callable checks
boundary_qualification.failure: Any missing zero boundary or mismatch yields unqualified; no formal training begins
boundary_qualification.reset: Reset common initial weights and optimizer after qualification before epoch1
